These stream retries introduce a few concerns:

- [more just a thought, not an issue] Tool activity and subsequent text stay buffered until completion. Could provider-owned tools retain live progress here? 

- [telemetry] When a failed stream retries without emitting a finish event, its Langfuse span never closes or exports, hiding that attempt from the trace. Could it close before the next attempt starts?
